title: TetriZZ / Players and games
description: Read from the PostgreSQL database. Daily numbers come from the nightly rollups (kept for ever); the rest comes from raw rows, which are kept for 30 days (events) or 180 days (games, sessions). Times are UTC.

panels.title: Players

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Players" FROM players WHERE telemetry_opt_out = 0

panels.description: Anonymous installations seen so far, without those that switched usage data off.

panels.title: Games, all time

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(value), 0) AS "Games" FROM daily_stats WHERE metric = 'games' AND dim = 'all'

panels.description: Games played, from the rollups. A match of several players counts once.

panels.title: Active today

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(value), 0) AS "Active today" FROM daily_stats WHERE metric = 'players_active' AND dim = 'all' AND day = to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

panels.description: Players with a session or a game since midnight UTC (refreshed by the janitor every few minutes).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS "Players" FROM sessions WHERE started_at >= (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - 86400000::bigint * 7
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS "Players" FROM sessions WHERE started_at >= (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - 86400000::bigint * 30

panels.title: Play time, all time (hours)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(value), 0) / 3600000.0 AS "Hours" FROM daily_stats WHERE metric = 'play_ms' AND dim = 'all'

panels.description: Length of finished games, added up.

panels.title: Games per day, by mode

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::date::timestamp AS time, substr(dim, 6) AS metric, value FROM daily_stats WHERE metric = 'games' AND dim LIKE 'mode:%' AND day::date BETWEEN (to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND (to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: Modes are the names the page sends: endless, sprint, ultra, practice, vs-<mode> and online-<mode>.

panels.title: Active and new players per day

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::date::timestamp AS time, CASE metric WHEN 'players_active' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'New' END AS metric, value FROM daily_stats WHERE metric IN ('players_active', 'players_new') AND dim = 'all' AND day::date BETWEEN (to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND (to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT day::date::timestamp AS time, value / 3600000.0 AS "Hours" FROM daily_stats WHERE metric = 'play_ms' AND dim = 'all' AND day::date BETWEEN (to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND (to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::date::timestamp AS time, substr(dim, 8) AS metric, value FROM daily_stats WHERE metric = 'games' AND dim LIKE 'device:%' AND day::date BETWEEN (to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND (to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT day::date::timestamp AS time, value AS "Sessions" FROM daily_stats WHERE metric = 'sessions' AND dim = 'all' AND day::date BETWEEN (to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND (to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date ORDER BY 1

SELECT substr(dim, 6) AS "Mode", SUM(value) AS "Games" FROM daily_stats WHERE metric = 'games' AND dim LIKE 'mode:%' AND day::date BETWEEN (to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AND (to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Do new players come back?

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT DISTINCT player_id, (to_timestamp(started_at / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS d FROM sessions), c AS (SELECT id, (to_timestamp(first_seen / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS d0 FROM players WHERE telemetry_opt_out = 0 AND first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000), f AS (SELECT c.d0, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s WHERE s.player_id = c.id AND s.d = c.d0 + 1) AS next_day, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s WHERE s.player_id = c.id AND s.d BETWEEN c.d0 + 1 AND c.d0 + 7) AS within_week FROM c) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "New players", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d0 < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date) AS "Old enough for next day", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE next_day AND d0 < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d0 < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date), 0), 1) AS "Back the next day %", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d0 <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - 7) AS "Old enough for a week", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE within_week AND d0 <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - 7) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d0 <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - 7), 0), 1) AS "Back within 7 days %" FROM f

panels.description: Players who first appeared in the selected range. "Next day" means a session on the calendar day after the first one; "within 7 days" means any session on days 1 to 7. Only players old enough are counted in each percentage. Sessions are kept for 180 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(app_version, 'unknown') AS "Version", COUNT(*) AS "Sessions", COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS "Players", to_timestamp(MAX(started_at) / 1000.0) AS "Last session" FROM sessions WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Devices (players seen in the range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.device->>'deviceClass' AS "Class", d.device->>'os' AS "System", d.device->>'osVersion' AS "Version", d.device->>'browser' AS "Browser", COUNT(*) AS "Players" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_id) player_id, device FROM player_devices WHERE last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000 ORDER BY player_id, last_seen DESC) d GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY 5 DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: Each player counted once, by the newest device description seen in the range.

panels.title: Performance by device class

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(s.device_class, 'unknown') AS "Class", COUNT(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'fps') = 'number' AND abs((e.payload->>'fps')::numeric) < 1000000000 THEN (e.payload->>'fps')::numeric END) AS "Samples", ROUND((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'fps') = 'number' AND abs((e.payload->>'fps')::numeric) < 1000000000 THEN (e.payload->>'fps')::numeric END))::numeric, 0) AS "Median fps", ROUND((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'p95Ms') = 'number' AND abs((e.payload->>'p95Ms')::numeric) < 1000000000 THEN (e.payload->>'p95Ms')::numeric END))::numeric, 1) AS "Typical p95 frame ms", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'thinkMs') = 'number' AND abs((e.payload->>'thinkMs')::numeric) < 1000000000 THEN (e.payload->>'thinkMs')::numeric END), 1) AS "Bot think ms", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'tier') = 'number' AND abs((e.payload->>'tier')::numeric) < 1000000000 THEN (e.payload->>'tier')::numeric END > 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'tier') = 'number' AND abs((e.payload->>'tier')::numeric) < 1000000000 THEN (e.payload->>'tier')::numeric END), 0), 1) AS "At reduced quality %" FROM events e LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.id = e.session_id WHERE e.kind = 'perf_sample' AND e.occurred_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: One sample per finished game or match of at least 120 frames. Raw events are kept for 30 days, so a longer range shows only the last 30.

panels.title: Script errors

targets.rawSql: SELECT payload->>'hash' AS "Hash", MAX(payload->>'name') AS "Error", MAX(payload->>'message') AS "Message", MAX(payload->>'where') AS "Where", COUNT(*) AS "Count", COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS "Players", to_timestamp(MAX(occurred_at) / 1000.0) AS "Last seen" FROM events WHERE kind = 'js_error' AND occurred_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 5 DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Each page reports a distinct error once (at most five per page load). The message is cut to 120 characters with long tokens blanked.

panels.title: Online rooms per day, by backend

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', to_timestamp(occurred_at / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS time, (CASE kind WHEN 'room_create' THEN 'created' ELSE 'joined' END) || ' via ' || COALESCE(payload->>'backend', 'unknown') AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM events WHERE kind IN ('room_create', 'room_join') AND occurred_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: Rooms made or joined through the online lobby, by the backend that carried them. LAN rooms are not counted.
